text.title: Portfolio EVM Rollup Method — Output Contract
text.summary: JSON Schema (draft-07) for the monthly portfolio EVM rollup: one data date and one currency, a per-project table with BAC / PV / EV / AC / SV / CV / SPI / CPI / EAC / VAC, the EV method and the EAC formula per row, stale projects listed apart with their BAC, a currency-sum aggregate that keeps LOE apart from discrete work, the weighting policy with unweighted figures beside weighted ones, a three-period SPI / CPI trend, named variance thresholds with a narrative only beyond them, and the money block (EAC vs BAC, VAC, fixed-bid margin). Validator in scripts/validate-portfolio-evm-rollup-method.py enforces it, including the sum-not-average arithmetic.

required.field: the portfolio owner who signs the rollup before the executive review, `role:handle` (03 human checkpoint)
the single data date every row is reported as of (r-single-data-date)
ISO 4217 code of the one reporting currency (r-rollup-sums-currency-not-indices)
`week`, `fortnight` or `month`; a ledger older than the data date by more than one period is stale (r-single-data-date)
the scheduled review the rollup is for; `owner_sign_off.signed_at` is on or before it
`spi_min`, `cpi_min`, `cv_pct_of_bac_max` and `policy_source`; a project beyond any of them carries a narrative, the rest carry none (r-variance-thresholds-named)
`policy` = `currency-sum` or a named weighting; any other policy names `policy_document` and every project carries `weight` (r-weighting-policy-declared)

at least 3 rows, each with `name`, `contract_type`, `ev_method`, `ledger_file`, `ledger_exported_at`, `data_date`, `currency`, `bac`, `pv`, `ev`, `ac`, `sv`, `cv`, `spi`, `cpi`, `eac`, `vac`, `eac_formula`, `trend[]` (3 data dates); fixed-bid rows add `contract_value` and `implied_margin`; rows beyond a threshold add `variance_narrative` (r-per-project-table-fields, r-normalise-contract-types, r-trend-three-periods)
projects excluded from the aggregate: `name`, `bac`, `last_data_date`, `ledger_exported_at`; empty when none are stale (r-single-data-date)

`discrete` (BAC, PV, EV, AC, SPI = sum EV / sum PV, CPI = sum EV / sum AC, EAC = sum of row EACs, VAC), `loe` (BAC, PV, EV, AC of level-of-effort rows), `trend[]` of 3 data dates, `weighted` when a weighting is applied (r-rollup-sums-currency-not-indices, r-normalise-contract-types, r-trend-three-periods, r-weighting-policy-declared)
`bac`, `eac`, `vac` in currency, `fixed_bid_margin_total`, `escalated_projects[]` = the rows beyond a threshold (r-eac-and-margin-in-money, r-variance-thresholds-named)

forbidden.pattern: `aggregate.discrete.spi` or `.cpi` equal to the mean of row indices instead of sum(EV) / sum(PV), sum(EV) / sum(AC) — fm-01
a row whose `data_date` differs from the artefact `data_date`, or a project in `projects[]` whose ledger is older than one reporting period — fm-02
`weighting.policy` other than `currency-sum` with no `policy_document`, no per-row `weight`, or no `aggregate.weighted` beside the unweighted figures — fm-04
`variance_narrative` on a row inside every threshold, or missing on a row beyond one — fm-05
fewer than 3 data dates in any `trend[]`, or a last trend point that disagrees with the current SPI / CPI — fm-06
`executive_summary` without `eac`, `vac` and `fixed_bid_margin_total` in currency, or `bac` / `eac` that do not equal discrete + LOE — fm-07
a level-of-effort row counted in `aggregate.discrete` — r-normalise-contract-types

list.item: Every row's `data_date` equals the artefact `data_date`; any project whose ledger is older than one `reporting_period` is in `stale_projects` with its BAC, not in `projects` (r-single-data-date).
`aggregate.discrete.spi` = sum(EV) / sum(PV) and `.cpi` = sum(EV) / sum(AC) over the non-LOE rows, in the one `currency`; no row index is averaged (r-rollup-sums-currency-not-indices).
Every row names its `ev_method`; fixed-bid rows use milestone-weight, 0/100 or 50/50; level-of-effort rows are summed in `aggregate.loe` only (r-normalise-contract-types).
Every row carries BAC, PV, EV, AC, SV, CV, SPI, CPI, EAC, VAC, `eac_formula`, `data_date` and `currency`, and EAC agrees with the named formula (r-per-project-table-fields).

`variance_thresholds` are numeric and sourced; rows beyond a threshold carry `variance_narrative` with cause and corrective action, rows inside carry none, and `executive_summary.escalated_projects` lists exactly the rows beyond (r-variance-thresholds-named).
Every row and the aggregate show a `trend[]` of at least 3 data dates whose last point is the current SPI / CPI (r-trend-three-periods).
A weighting other than `currency-sum` names its `policy_document`, prints `weight` per row and `aggregate.weighted` next to the unweighted figures (r-weighting-policy-declared).
`executive_summary` states `bac`, `eac`, `vac` in currency (discrete + LOE) and `fixed_bid_margin_total` = sum of fixed-bid `implied_margin` (r-eac-and-margin-in-money).
`owner_sign_off.signed_by` is the `owner` and `signed_at` is on or before `executive_review_date` (03 human checkpoint).
